Those aren't regular presents they're throwing, they'll buff other enemies!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 25 (Formerly, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Jester''' is a support enemy that appears in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It has the same speed as the [[Fallen Squire]] but it has much higher health than it. It has one ability, ''Devious Tricks'', which makes it throw a gift on the path which buffs enemies. This creates an explosion with an explosion radius of 5. This can apply either the [[Bloated]] or [[Blessed]] attributes. The '''Fallen Jester''' cannot buff itself, other '''Fallen Jesters''' or [[Boss]] enemies. The '''Fallen Jester''' will not target other '''Fallen Jesters''', itself, the [[Fallen Angel]], [[Fallen Seraph]], [[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]]Can only be seen in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. and the [[Fallen King]], its [[Awakened Fallen King]] form included. This, however, does not mean they cannot receive attributes from it. As long as they are not a '''Fallen Jester''' or a [[Boss]], they can still receive them, just indirectly. ==Logbook Description== "''Fallen Jesters entertained the royal court, their performances bringing joy even as hope vanished along with the magic. They put on spectacular shows and gave gifts unlike anything anyone had seen, yet they could never change the despair seen in the faces of their audience. The day the Queen died, as did their laughter. The curse turned their gifts into tainted presents that strengthen their army. Their performances continue, but no one is there to watch.''" ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Jester''' wears a black and blue jester outfit and shoes, a brown belt and black and grey comedy mask. It has black gloves with grey spiked arm-bands. It has black horns on its shoulders. It holds a black and blue present which it uses to buff enemies with. It has a death animation where it falls over on its back, its present falling on its face in the process. ==Strategy== *The '''Fallen Jester''' should be killed as soon as possible. While it is not dangerous on its own, its ability to buff other enemies can make it very dangerous. **DPS towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Minigunner]] can be used to kill it. **Stalling towers like the [[Tesla]] or [[Freezer]] can be used to slow down the '''Fallen Jester'''. *The [[Gatling Gun]] is extremely useful against this enemy, as you can manually shoot at it first as well as enemies nearby when using ''FPS'' mode to kill it before it uses its ''Devious Tricks'' ability. However, if it is low level, it might not be able to kill the '''Fallen Jester''' fast enough. *On its debut wave, three [[Fallen Giant]]s appear alongside it. This combination is highly dangerous because the '''Fallen Jester''' can apply [[Bloated]] and [[Blessed]] to them, giving them a total of 8,000 health with 100% defense each and a combined total of 24,000 health. **It is reccommended to first set some of your towers to ''Last'' so they can directly target the '''Fallen Jester''', as it spawns behind the [[Fallen Giant]]s. If it uses its ''Devious Tricks'' ability on them, set your ''Last'' targeting towers to ''Weakest'' and keep the rest of your towers attacking the buffed [[Fallen Giant]]s. **The [[Saboteur]] can also be used to force your towers to target it. *Defense melting towers such as the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Toxic Gunner]] are extremely beneficial in lowering the high 100% defense applied by the '''Fallen Jester''' to enemies from the [[Blessed]] status effect, in addition to enemies that already have defense applied to them by default, added with the 100% defense mechanism. **Additionally, splash damage towers like the [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] are effective as they fully ignore defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FallenJesterWalk.gif|Walking animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenJesterThrow.gif|''Devious Tricks'' animation (2 August 2024 – Present) FallenJesterDeath.gif|''Death'' animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FallenJester.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFallenJester.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - "Prepare Your Defenses" Trailer|'''Fallen Jester''' on a promotional video.
